plan: Model the component as a CheckInConsole class holding a defensive copy of appointments and a public session dict with exactly the four contracted keys.

Dispatch actions through a type-to-handler table; each handler validates action shape and session preconditions fully before any mutation, returning an 'Error:' screen on failure so accepted data is never corrupted and handle never raises.

Centralize output in a _screen(prompt, messages) factory that builds the exact {prompt, messages, choices} shape and includes fresh appointment choice copies exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.

Implement transitions per contract: begin only when inactive (in-place reset preserving the session dict identity), contact/choice/correct only when active and incomplete, complete gated on confirmed contact plus selected appointment, abandon resetting to the initial session; corrections resolve their follow-up prompt via a next-unmet-prompt helper.

Inject action_source and screen_sink via the constructor so unittest fakes (any objects with read_action/display) plug in; run_once raises RuntimeError before touching either when one is missing, then reads one action, handles it, displays the screen once, and returns the same screen object.
mechanisms: State-guarded action dispatch table (validate-then-mutate handlers keyed by action type)
Single screen factory enforcing the frozen screen shape and the choices-only-on-'Choose appointment' invariant
In-place session reset preserving the public dict reference
Constructor dependency injection of action source and screen sink for standard-library test fakes
